verdicts.title: The Tutte Polynomial of Complex Reflection Groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This article computes the Tutte polynomial of the hyperplane arrangements associated to the complex reflection groups. The calculations are based on both formulas of De Concini and Procesi for Tutte polynomial and the normaliser of parabolic subgroups in complex reflection groups determined by Krishnasamy and Taylor.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract only computes Tutte polynomials of hyperplane arrangements for complex reflection groups; it makes no mention of Brauer groups, resolution proof width, or d-regular graphs, so it shares only the 'Tutte polynomial' vocabulary with the conjecture.

verdicts.title: The Tutte Polynomial of the Schreier graphs of the Grigorchuk group and the Basilica group
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study the Tutte polynomial of two infinite families of finite graphs. These are the Schreier graphs associated with the action of two well-known self-similar groups acting on the binary rooted tree by automorphisms: the first Grigorchuk group of intermediate growth, and the iterated monodromy group of the complex polynomial $z^2-1$ known as the Basilica group. verdicts.title: $G$-Tutte polynomials and abelian Lie group arrangements
